description: This Java class `OpenApiConfig` is a Spring Boot configuration component that sets up the OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation for the REST API. It dynamically configures the server URL based on request headers, primarily for environments behind proxies or load balancers. The class defines OpenAPI metadata such as title, version, description, contact, and license, and conditionally adds a server URL if accessible via forwarded headers.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up OpenAPI documentation with dynamic server URL resolution based on request headers.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenAPI object with metadata and possibly adds a server URL based on forwarded headers.

methods.name: resolveServerUrl
methods.description: Resolves the server URL from X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Host, and X-Forwarded-Port headers to support proxy environments.
